tests.test_name: owner autosave persists bounded incomplete text and refuses cross-account writes
tests.keep_because: Another account cannot overwrite a private draft; a rejected write leaves the stored draft intact.

tests.test_name: a key outside the configured set signs nothing
tests.keep_because: Tokens signed by an untrusted key cannot establish identity; this exercises the shared verifier with actual disposable signing keys.

tests.test_name: COMPLETE_PAIR_REQUIRED: a half, blank, duplicated or unverifiable pair is refused before a write
tests.keep_because: Incomplete, swapped, mismatched or invalid authentication evidence is refused without changing account evidence.

tests.test_name: CSRF is required for both session creation and deletion
tests.keep_because: A cross-site request cannot create or delete the browser session without CSRF protection.

tests.test_name: EXACT_AMOUNTS_AND_PRICES: only exact eighteen-decimal amounts and positive prices review
tests.keep_because: Malformed, nonpositive or over-precision amounts/prices cannot enter a bid review, and a long amount is read exactly, never rounded.

tests.test_name: exact maximum is floored to the pinned zero-based grid without decimal rounding
tests.keep_because: Tick alignment never rounds a bid above the requested maximum; encoded calldata carries the aligned integer.

tests.test_name: tick boundaries, clearing floor, cap and huge precision use exact integer bounds
tests.keep_because: Price floors, caps, tick boundaries and integer overflow are enforced without floating-point arithmetic.

tests.test_name: BOUND_REGENT_CURRENCY: an auction raising anything else can neither be read nor bid on
tests.keep_because: A bid cannot silently spend a currency other than the configured REGENT currency.

tests.test_name: ACTIVE_WALLET_IS_THE_SIGNER: an unlinked wallet exposes nothing and prepares nothing
tests.keep_because: An unlinked wallet cannot expose a private bid position or prepare a bid.

tests.test_name: TREASURY_DRIFT_ENDS_EVERY_NEW_REVIEW
tests.keep_because: A treasury whose security changed since it was verified gets no new bid review.

tests.test_name: a receipt above the safe head stays pending rather than becoming an answer
tests.keep_because: A transaction above the safe chain head is not prematurely reported as settled.

tests.test_name: a receipt in a block that is no longer canonical stays pending
tests.keep_because: A receipt from a reorganized-out block cannot settle a launch.

tests.test_name: a canonical revert is terminal reverted
tests.keep_because: A reverted on-chain transaction is never reported as a successful launch.

tests.test_name: an approval event for a different amount or spender is unverified
tests.keep_because: An approval for a different amount or spender cannot authorize the reviewed sequence.

tests.test_name: an absent, duplicated or foreign-emitter event is never a launch
tests.keep_because: Missing, duplicate or foreign-contract events cannot count as launch evidence.

tests.test_name: an event naming another signer, treasury or raise is unverified
tests.keep_because: A launch event for another signer, treasury or raise amount cannot confirm this review.

tests.test_name: a verified local launch and bid project once under exact deterministic identities
tests.keep_because: Processing the same verified local launch/bid twice does not create duplicate records. This checks duplicate rows, not every possible replay effect.

tests.test_name: out-of-order position receipts cannot rewind claimed or graduated chain state
tests.keep_because: Late position receipts cannot turn a claimed bid or graduated auction back into an earlier state.

tests.test_name: a later invalid resource refuses and rolls the whole launch projection back
tests.keep_because: A failed multi-record launch projection rolls back instead of leaving partial financial records.

tests.test_name: hands the wallet the exact reviewed bytes from the reviewed signer and reports the hash once
tests.keep_because: A press sends exactly the step the server built, from the reviewed signer, with the chain read last, and reports its hash once against its own review.

tests.test_name: two presses in a row both reach the wallet while the first is still there
tests.keep_because: Two presses in a row both reach the wallet; nothing blocks, queues or merges a repeat press.

tests.test_name: sends nothing from a wallet other than the reviewed signer
tests.keep_because: A wallet other than the reviewed signer sends nothing, whether Privy or the wallet itself names the other account.

tests.test_name: sends nothing while the wallet is on another chain
tests.keep_because: Nothing is sent on the wrong chain, including a chain change after the switch.

tests.test_name: sends nothing when Privy changes the active wallet part-way
tests.keep_because: A press whose active wallet changes part-way sends nothing from either wallet.

tests.test_name: reports a declined request and a step the review does not have
tests.keep_because: A declined request and a step the review lacks are reported, with nothing else sent.

tests.test_name: LONG_STORED_PRICE: a bid estimate reads the whole stored price, never zero
tests.keep_because: A stored clearing price longer than 34 digits is read whole, so a bid below it is never estimated as buying now (live finding, 13 Oct 2026).

tests.test_name: HTML pages reject JSON selected by Accept or _format
tests.keep_because: JSON-selected HTML pages must return406 instead of crashing while encoding a LiveView safe-HTML tuple.

tests.test_name: a browser or an Accept header with an HTML fallback still gets LiveView HTML
tests.keep_because: Correcting JSON admission must keep HTML rendering and mixed Accept fallback working.

tests.test_name: the existing session fetch still returns JSON
tests.keep_because: JSON page rejection must preserve the existing wildcard and explicit-JSON session response.

tests.test_name: JSON account-link requests retain CSRF protection
tests.keep_because: X linking must admit its existing JSON format while continuing to reject requests without CSRF proof.

tests.test_name: SIGN_IN_ENDS_30_DAYS_AFTER_IT_WAS_MADE: a refresh never extends a sign-in
tests.keep_because: A sign-in ends 30 days after the bind that made it, however recently it was refreshed (Sean, 15 Oct 2026, decision 2a). A manual check cannot wait 30 days; the case fails if the bind stops recording the sign-in, if a refresh moves it, or if the end is counted from the last refresh again.

tests.test_name: LONG_POOL_PRICES_ARE_CUT_NOT_PARSED
tests.keep_because: Real pool prices run past Decimal's 34-digit parsing limit and may end in an ellipsis; parsing one crashed every token page with a pool price in review (Sentinel, 16 Oct 2026), and short test prices miss it. The case fails if copied details parse a price again or cut it differently from the page.

tests.test_name: hands wallet_sendCalls exactly the reviewed calls, atomically, after the chain read
tests.keep_because: BATCH_SENDS_ONLY_THE_REVIEW_ATOMICALLY: one Claim rewards press sends settle, every collect and claimAll together; the wallet must get exactly the server's calls, in order, from the reviewed signer, with atomicity required and the chain read last. A lab without a batching wallet cannot show this.

tests.test_name: sends nothing when the wallet cannot send the calls atomically, and says so
tests.keep_because: BATCH_SENDS_ONLY_THE_REVIEW_ATOMICALLY: a wallet that cannot send the calls atomically must send none of them, and the page must go back to one step at a time, where each press shows what it sends.

tests.test_name: BATCH_IS_THE_REVIEWS_ONLY_WITH_EVERY_CALL
tests.keep_because: A batch's transaction goes to the sender's own address or the entry point, never to the reviewed contract, so the usual target and calldata check cannot apply. A transaction is the review's only when it carries every reviewed call in order for the reviewed signer, and a smart account's ran only when the canonical EntryPoint itself records success; the page says Claimed only when the receipt also holds the launch splitter's own Claimed record for the signer, and otherwise that nothing was waiting. The case fails if a log from another contract is accepted as the entry point's, or a successful transaction without the claim record is called Claimed. No lab wallet sends batches, so manual review cannot reach this.

tests.test_name: ACCOUNT_SHOWS_A_PAIRED_AGENT
tests.keep_because: The Account page builds each paired agent's row for the shared agents list, and a row missing a field the list reads crashed /account for everyone with a paired agent (v140, 16 Oct 2026). A signed-out or unpaired review never sees it. The case fails if /account stops mounting with a paired agent or stops showing its name and kind.

tests.test_name: a draft refuses hidden characters in a field, and a website must be a full link to launch
tests.keep_because: A null byte in a draft field reached the database and failed the save with no field marked, and a website that was not a link passed launch review and would be written into the token (found 17 Oct 2026). The case fails if a hidden character is saved instead of marked on its field, if a description loses its line breaks, or if a non-link website counts as complete.

tests.test_name: an auction page whose auction cannot be read is a 503 with Try again, not a 404
tests.keep_because: A failed read of an auction or token page answered the site's 404, telling people and search engines a live page was gone, and logged nothing (found 17 Oct 2026). The case fails if a failed read stops answering 503 with Try again.

tests.test_name: an address that cannot name an auction is the not-found page
tests.keep_because: v146 answered an address that cannot name any auction (a tail that is not hex) with the 503 Try again page instead of not found (found live 17 Oct 2026). The case fails if such an address stops answering 404.

tests.test_name: WALLET_VIDEO_ONLY_FOR_ITS_OWNER: anyone else finds nothing at the address
tests.keep_because: A wallet's share video shows its bids, trades, stake and earnings, so only the signed-in account that links the wallet may fetch it, at the token's address and at the auction's (share video, 18 Oct 2026). Signed out or signed in as another account, both addresses are not found; the owner reaches the video, whose chain read failing says so (502) rather than not found. A manual check sees only the owner's own view. The case fails if either wallet check is dropped or loosened.

tests.test_name: share video cap holds under concurrent requests
tests.keep_because: Share videos asked for by many people at once, and by one person from several tabs at once, still hold the site to 1000 videos in 24 hours, each video is queued once however many ask for it together, and a person's tabs all get the same answer (1000-a-day cap, 18 Oct 2026). The asks run in their own processes and commit on their own connections, which no manual check can time. It fails if either part is undone: with the cap's lock removed it failed 3 of 3 runs (two videos made with room for one), and with a queued video no longer let through at the cap, 3 of 3 (one tab told the day's videos were all made while its video was queued).

tests.test_name: a person's video is kept until three hours have passed, then made again
tests.keep_because: A person's made share video is stored and served as made for three hours, a new one is made after that with the old one kept, and once the site has made all of the day's videos a person keeps their saved video while one with none is told so (stored videos, 18 Oct 2026). Checking it by hand means waiting three hours and filling the day's 1000 videos.

tests.test_name: SAVED_VIDEO_GOES_AFTER_A_DAY_REQUEST_STAYS: a day-old video is deleted and its request kept
tests.keep_because: Sean chose "Saved videos only" (19 Oct 2026): the daily sweep deletes a saved video's bytes once it is a day old and keeps the request row. The case fails if the sweep deletes rows or keeps day-old videos.

tests.test_name: once saved videos are full, a video is still made, handed over once and never saved
tests.keep_because: Once the saved share videos reach their space (5 GB on the site), a new video is still made and handed over once, then let go; no video is ever deleted early (Sean, 19 Oct 2026). Filling 5 GB by hand is not practical. It fails if a video made past the space were kept after it was handed over (proven by serving it as a saved one: its bytes stayed).

tests.test_name: SHARE_VIDEO_OUTAGE_ONLY_FOR_A_LOST_CONNECTION: a lost database connection is the try-again page
tests.keep_because: The site's try-again page (503) is only for a database that cannot be reached (Sentinel pre-read, 18 Oct 2026). The case cuts its own database connection from a second connection part-way through a share-video request, which no manual check can time, and the request must answer 503. It fails if a lost connection is classed as any other failure (proven by switching the check off: 500 instead of 503).

tests.test_name: a video that couldn't be made answers with its own line, not the try-again page
tests.keep_because: A video whose render failed answers 500 with its own plain line, which the share window shows, instead of the outage page (Sentinel pre-read, 18 Oct 2026). Before this change every share-video failure raised the 503 outage page.

tests.test_name: a connection lost before the request reads the video's queue is the try-again page
tests.keep_because: A database connection lost before the share-video request reads the video's queue answers the 503 try-again page, not a 500 (Sentinel verdict on 6fb2be2, 18 Oct 2026). The case cuts its own connection as that read starts, which no manual check can time. It fails if a lost connection on a read is classed as any other failure (proven by switching that off: 500).

tests.test_name: a connection lost while counting a queued video's place in line is the try-again page
tests.keep_because: A database connection lost while counting a queued video's place in line answers 503 (Sentinel verdict on 6fb2be2, 18 Oct 2026). Ash raises the database's own exception from a count, which answered 500 at 6fb2be2; the case failed there and passes now.

tests.test_name: a database error that is not a lost connection answers with its own line
tests.keep_because: A real database error that is not a lost connection (42P01, the table renamed inside the case's transaction) answers 500 with its own plain line, not the 503 try-again page (Sentinel verdict on 6fb2be2, 18 Oct 2026). It fails if the list of connection codes is widened to take in other database errors (proven by widening it: 503). Its log line names only the error's module as Ash hands it over, with neither the table nor the code read from the message.

tests.test_name: every lost-connection code the database reports answers the try-again page
tests.keep_because: Every connection-exception code (class 08) and every server shutdown or start code (57P01 to 57P03), raised by the database itself on the share-video write, answers the 503 try-again page (coordinator ruling, 19 Oct 2026 01:14Z). It fails if the fixed banner list is switched off or narrowed.

tests.test_name: a database code next to a lost connection's answers with its own line
tests.keep_because: Database codes beside the lost-connection ones (57P04, 57P05, 57014, 0A000), and a message that is a whole lost-connection banner ("** (Postgrex.Error) FATAL 57P01 (admin_shutdown) terminating connection"), answer 500 with their own line, not the try-again page (coordinator ruling, 19 Oct 2026 01:14Z). It fails if the banner list is widened. It also fails if the anchored check becomes a contains check.

tests.test_name: a connection that waits too long for the database is the try-again page
tests.keep_because: A share-video read dropped from the connection queue (DBConnection.ConnectionError, a real queue timeout) answers 503 (coordinator ruling, 19 Oct 2026 01:14Z). It fails if the banner check is switched off or loses the DBConnection.ConnectionError banner.

tests.test_name: no word of a database error's message reaches the log
tests.keep_because: A database error whose message holds a value (a trigger raising "alice 0xab1") leaves none of it in any log line at any level, the database layer's own query lines included (coordinator ruling, 19 Oct 2026 01:14Z). It fails if the log line carries the error's text.

tests.test_name: a connection that waits too long to count a queued video's place in line is the try-again page
tests.keep_because: A queued video's place-in-line count dropped from the connection queue raises the connection's own DBConnection.ConnectionError, unwrapped by Ash, and answers 503 (coordinator ruling, 19 Oct 2026 01:35Z). It is the only real path to the raw DBConnection.ConnectionError clause and fails when that clause is off.

tests.test_name: SAVED_VIDEOS_CAP_IS_5_GB: the site saves made videos only up to 5 GB
tests.keep_because: Sean: "Breaking the 5GB cap is not good, I dont want that database bill" (19 Oct 2026). The case reads the config the site ships with and fails if the saved-video ceiling there moves from 5 GB.

tests.test_name: a video made but not yet handed over counts toward the saved space
tests.keep_because: The 5 GB space count must include videos made but not yet handed over, or the cap can be passed. The case fails if the count leaves unsaved videos out.

tests.test_name: RENDER_HONOURS_SAVED_SPACE: a video made past the line is served but not saved
tests.keep_because: A share video rendered while the saved videos hold just under the saved space is saved; one rendered at or past it is still made and handed over once, but not saved (Sentinel's ask before v154, 19 Oct 2026). The real render runs from a queued request on a stored running auction, with only the chain node, ffmpeg and the space stood in, which filling 5 GB by hand cannot match. It fails if the render ignores the space check (saved always true) or ignores the configured space (the 5 GB constant put back): both mutations failed it.

tests.test_name: HEALTH_NAMES_THE_COMMIT: a ready site answers ok with its build's commit
tests.keep_because: The release checklist requires the health endpoint to name the deployed commit; v153's /healthz answered only "ok" (Sentinel, 19 Oct 2026). The case fails if a ready site stops naming its build's commit.

tests.test_name: PIXEL_CAP: a 40,000 by 40,000 interlaced PNG under 2 MB is refused from its header, never decoded
tests.keep_because: An upload decoding to more than 4096 by 4096 pixels is refused from its header before libvips or zlib touches it; a 2 MB interlaced PNG otherwise decodes to 1.6 GB (Sentinel hold on f23984b2, 19 Oct 2026). Without the cap the same file is accepted after an 18-second full decode.

tests.test_name: PIXEL_CAP: JPEG and WebP headers are capped the same way, a moving WebP counting every frame
tests.keep_because: The cap reads the JPEG frame header and the WebP VP8, VP8L and VP8X headers, counts every frame of a moving WebP, and is not fooled by a one-pixel canvas holding a larger picture. It fails if any format skips the header check.

tests.test_name: a normal picture still passes, decoded in full
tests.keep_because: The cap refuses nothing an ordinary picture needs: the 480 by 720 JPEG and the PNG fixtures pass, fully decoded. It also shows the call record sees a decode, so the never-decoded cases are not vacuous.

tests.test_name: RESIZE_ONE_AT_A_TIME: two copies asked for at once are made one after the other
tests.keep_because: A sized copy decodes the whole original, so Autolaunch.StoredImage.Resizer makes one at a time (Sentinel hold on f23984b2, 19 Oct 2026). With both requests queued, the second decode starts only after the first returns; it fails if copies are made side by side.

tests.test_name: RESIZE_SKIPS_A_CALLER_THAT_GAVE_UP: a request past its caller's deadline is not made
tests.keep_because: A request carries the moment its caller stops waiting, and one whose turn comes after that makes no decode (lead decision, 19 Oct 2026). It fails if the resizer decodes for a caller that has given up.
